workbook_path: data/Hungry F&B Database.Public Access 2026-10-17 Verified Menu Catalogue Refresh 40.xlsx
scope: Small targeted scout for exact-outlet, first-party image URLs with an explicit reuse license/permission or clearly stated rights. No paid sources, API calls, image downloads, or workbook edits.

method.comparison: Reviewed existing Image Candidates headers, rights-status patterns, and existing Wikimedia Commons entries. The current list already contains review-only CC candidates, including Shashlik, Tian Tian, 328 Katong Laksa, Ya Kun, Din Tai Fung, and others; no new first-party permission-granting URL was identified in the targeted scout.
queries: Singapore restaurant official website Creative Commons Attribution food images
Singapore hawker stall official website CC BY photos license
Singapore restaurant media assets image usage rights official restaurant photos
Singapore F&B image usage copyright official media kit

excluded_examples.subject: Tian Tian Hainanese Chicken Rice dish photo
excluded_examples.rights: CC BY-SA 4.0 reported in current workbook candidate; attribution/share-alike conditions apply.
excluded_examples.why_not_added: Third-party Wikimedia Commons source, not an official first-party image URL. The current candidate has no SFA licence and explicitly says exact licence needs verification, so it does not satisfy exact-outlet matching for this batch. Existing workbook entry left untouched.

excluded_examples.subject: General Singapore hawker-centre or dish photographs
excluded_examples.rights: Individual Commons files carry individual licenses; examples include CC BY-SA 4.0.
excluded_examples.why_not_added: Centre-level/general imagery does not identify an exact licensed outlet or stall and is not a first-party outlet asset.

excluded_examples.subject: Official restaurant-site imagery without a reuse grant
excluded_examples.rights: Official terms reserve intellectual-property rights and state that product photos/images are part of platform/promotional material; no reuse permission identified.
excluded_examples.why_not_added: Official provenance alone is not a reuse grant; excluded from image rows requiring permission for display.

rights_reference.summary: IPOS says not to assume internet material is free to copy; check website terms and use Creative Commons materials only in accordance with their license attributes.

result.reason: The targeted public search did not surface a first-party outlet asset with explicit permission or a license that clearly authorizes the intended catalogue display. Commons results can offer reuse terms, but are third-party submissions and do not meet the requested first-party-image constraint.
result.next_step: For official photos whose pages reserve rights or do not state reuse terms, request written permission from the outlet/operator before upgrading a review-only URL for display.
